github.copilot.chat.codeGeneration.instr.text: Types: All types and interfaces are in @fin-compass/types, import from there in core/base apps
Icons: Use lucide-react for all icons
Structure: Use /views folder instead of /components in apps
Follow existing: useApiCall hook, Zustand stores, Prisma patterns
API: Routes/Controller/service/validation structure, proper error handling in stores
Import order: React, @fin-compass packages, lucide icons, then relative imports
Services: Create CRUD services in /pages/{entity}/services/ folder following useGetProfile.ts pattern
Service Structure: Import useApiRequest, API_ENDPOINTS, API_METHODS, entity store, and types from @fin-compass/types
Store Integration: Services should use entity store actions (setLoading, setError, addEntity, updateEntity, removeEntity) instead of returning API state
Service Returns: Only return action functions and cancelAPIRequest, not apiResponse/apiLoading/apiError - components consume state from store selectors
API Endpoints: Define all endpoints in shared/constants/api.ts with proper naming (GET_ENTITY, CREATE_ENTITY, UPDATE_ENTITY, DELETE_ENTITY)
Store Pattern: Create Zustand stores with state (entities, selectedEntity, loading states, error states), actions (CRUD + setters), and selectors for performance
Error Handling: Each CRUD operation has separate error state in store, clear errors on success, set specific error messages in status handlers
Loading States: Use store loading actions in useApiRequest loaderAction option, separate loading state per operation
Status Handlers: Implement specific status handlers (200/201 for success, 400 for validation, 404 for not found) that update store directly
Store Updates: Success callbacks should update store (setEntities, addEntity, updateEntity, removeEntity) and clear errors
Component Usage: Components import store selectors for state and service hooks for actions, no direct API state consumption
